text:
ITEM 1 | Bright red raspberries, clustered in a mound in the upper-middle of the plate, glossy with a slightly bumpy drupelet surface, soft and juicy-looking, roughly 5-6 cm across the cluster, about 2 cm tall, sitting partly on the blackberries and dark jerky strip | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black blackberries, several whole round berries with bumpy drupelet texture and a slight sheen, about 2-2.5 cm each, scattered at upper-left, left edge and center-right of the cluster, plump and moist-looking | 45
ITEM 3 | Dark reddish-brown flat strip, smooth and slightly matte with a faintly fibrous, dry-looking surface, running diagonally from upper-right to lower-center, about 16 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, about 0.5 cm thick, firm and holding its shape | 40
ITEM 4 | Yellow pineapple pieces, irregular chunks and wedges with a bright golden color, slightly translucent edges, moist surface with a faint sheen, each piece about 2-3 cm, scattered at lower-right and right of the jerky strip, firm and holding shape | 75
ITEM 5 | Small dark blackberry or berry fragments, one small dark purple piece near the center-left below the raspberries, about 1.5 cm, moist and glossy | 5
